records.name: Ampersand font explorer
records.classification: designer launch with media and a live desktop fallback

discussion.finding: A reply liked sharing a font preview without a full install and asked for the sample sentence to travel with the link. The author said that case was not supported yet.

records.action: Advance the post gallery from image 4 to 5 and return. Open the exact shared font on desktop and follow Open in Google Fonts.
records.observed: The gallery showed two sharp 943 × 2048 source images. The desktop share is one 1280 × 900 viewport with no additional scroll range. The fallback opened the Playfair specimen.
records.transfer: Put the useful specimen in the focal position. Make the handoff action reach the exact item in the new context.
records.limit: The gallery documents the mobile UI. Native app controls and the optical clock animation were not exercised.

records.name: UI SDK quick start
records.classification: designer discussion pointing to live documentation

discussion.finding: A reply preferred keeping a choice of how to install even when the prompt is the main quick start.

records.action: Open the Framework combobox with Enter, select Vue with ArrowDown, and commit with Enter.

records.transfer: Show one runnable first task and keep verified manual install commands available. When a user changes a setting, keep the result near the control and confirm focus.
